chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"I am only a human being like you."
I marry among you and I give you in marriage, except Fāṭimah, for indeed her marriage descended from the heaven.

key_terms.أَتَزَوَّجُ: I marry, referring to the Prophet’s own marriages
key_terms.أُزَوِّجُكُمْ: I give you in marriage, meaning I arrange marriages among you
key_terms.بَشَرٌ: a human being, emphasizing the Prophet’s human nature
key_terms.تَزْوِيجَهَا: her marriage, referring specifically to Fāṭimah’s union
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, the daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.مِثْلُكُمْ: like you, indicating similarity to other people in humanity
key_terms.ٱلسَّمَاءِ: the heaven, indicating divine heavenly origin

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the heavenly marriage of Fāṭimah عليها السلام?
ai.summary: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله declared his human nature while distinguishing the marriage of Fāṭimah عليها السلام as a matter ordained from heaven. The hadith highlights the unique rank and divine distinction of Fāṭimah عليها السلام within the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4382 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"I am only a human being like you;

I marry amongst you and I arrange marriages for you.
Except for Sayyida Fatimah {s.a}, for her marriage was decreed from the heavens."
